title: Lab - Horizontal Pod Autoscaler
description: Create an HPA and make it scale.
scenario: Create an HPA and make it scale. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create
tasks.instructions: Create an HPA for Deployment php-apache: 50% CPU, 1 to 10 replicas.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Load
tasks.instructions: Generate load from a busybox loop and watch replicas grow.
tasks.solution: kubectl run load --rm -it --image=busybox -- /bin/sh -c "while true; do wget -q -O- http://php-apache; done"

tasks.title: Task 3 - Cool down
tasks.instructions: Stop the load and watch the HPA scale back down.
tasks.verification: kubectl get hpa  # replicas return to 1 after the stabilisation window
